set.tovw: Ruse: exposed as a 1911 newspaper hoax

tw-mi-buchanan-burton-phonograph.st: Exposed as a hoax: the Niles paper called the 1911 phonograph-will story fake, written by a correspondent who wanted candy money (it ran on 31 March).

set.tovw: Gone: loot spent and recovered in 1895; no Michigan cache

tw-mi-mcbain-smalley-train-loot-1895.st: A gang member's 1895 confession: the loot came from an 1893 Indiana express robbery; his share was spent on property at McBain and about $2,700 plus jewellery was recovered there. Only papers were said to be buried, in Indiana. No Michigan cache.
